meaning.en: (physics) The ratio of the energy of a wave reflected from a surface to the energy possessed by the wave striking the surface.
meaning.vi: (vật lý) Tỷ số giữa năng lượng của sóng phản xạ từ bề mặt và năng lượng của sóng truyền tới bề mặt.

meaning_vi: hệ số phản xạ, hệ số phản chiếu

sentences.en: It also measured the radar emissivity, radar reflectivity, gravity and radio occultation data.

sentences.en: The second section delves into the techniques and theory behind the applications such as specular X-ray reflectivity, diffraction imaging and defect mapping.

sentences.en: Combine that with its reflectivity features, and you've got yourself one fine shoe.

sentences.en: Another class has extremely high reflectivity with absolutely no evidence of absorption of light by ferrous iron.
